policies.title: Bangladeshi ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Bangladesh as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bangladeshi passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Bangladeshi ordinary passports: Panama advance authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule places Bangladesh in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring approval before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bangladeshi passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Authorized-visa approval can take up to 60 business days and must be granted before travel.
Washington-specific filing mechanics are not generalized to every consular district; final admission remains discretionary.

policies.title: Bangladeshi ordinary passports: Türkiye advance visitor visa baseline
policies.summary: Türkiye's Foreign Ministry requires ordinary Bangladeshi passport holders to have a visa; eVisa access depends on qualifying third-country documentation.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bangladeshi passport holder travelling as a short visitor without a qualifying Schengen, United States, United Kingdom or Irish visa or residence permit.
The conditional eVisa alternative does not change the passport-wide baseline.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: Türkiye's live Foreign Ministry register makes eVisa access conditional on qualifying third-country documents; the unconditional ordinary-passport baseline requires a visa.
